list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text,environment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context ORDER BY 1

list.name: deployment
list.label: Deployment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT deployment AS __text,deployment AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context WHERE environment=${environment:sqlstring} ORDER BY 1

list.name: chain
list.label: Source chain
list.query: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role
list.definition: SELECT role||' · '||chain_id::text AS __text,chain_instance_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} ORDER BY role

list.name: rollup
list.label: L2 rollup
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT rollup_id::text AS __text,rollup_id::text AS __value FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND role='l2' ORDER BY 1

list.name: instance
list.label: Native instance
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT s.instance AS __text,s.instance AS __value FROM eez.lifecycle_coverage s WHERE s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Attempt activity is not paid settlement
panels.description: Preparations, per-group simulation, actual blocking witness work, signer RPC/worker stages and submission observations are operational measurements. They overlap and must not be added into end-to-end latency. Included submission is not canonical request completion. Restarts reset counters and immutable policy settings; missing stages mean unexercised or unavailable, not zero latency. Canonical posting and applied-range tables below use independent chain anchors.

options.content: Preparations, per-group simulation, actual blocking witness work, signer RPC/worker stages and submission observations are operational measurements. They overlap and must not be added into end-to-end latency. Included submission is not canonical request completion. Restarts reset counters and immutable policy settings; missing stages mean unexercised or unavailable, not zero latency. Canonical posting and applied-range tables below use independent chain anchors.

panels.title: Stage p95 by typed outcome · native
panels.description: Aggregate compatible histogram buckets per stage/outcome across selected instances, never average percentiles. Simulation observes individual complete-group executions; witness observes the actual blocking worker; signer total includes ingestion/validation/settlement/signing; submission includes relay/inclusion observation. Stages overlap. No series means not observed.

panels.title: Stage observations by outcome · native
panels.description: Operational observation counts across selected instances. Must not be treated as canonical batches.

panels.title: Retained candidate / retry / dispatch observations
panels.description: Best-effort lifecycle event population; repeated attempts remain separate from actual paid receipts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.payload#>>'{event,event}' AS event,count(*) AS observations FROM eez.lifecycle_event_history e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND e.payload#>>'{event,event}' IN ('preparation_started','preparation_finished','attempt_prepared','attempt_repriced','dispatched','submission_observed','reconciled','reorg') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Canonical paid posting calls
panels.description: Includes reverted calls. Exact integer costs; successful receipt alone does not prove applied cross-chain effects. Sums include known charges only; any incomplete-receipt count means the complete population total is unknown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.success,count(*) AS receipts,sum(r.execution_paid)::text AS known_execution_paid_wei,sum(r.blob_paid)::text AS known_blob_paid_wei FROM eez.posting_receipts r JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(r.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND r.source_valid GROUP BY r.success

panels.title: Attempt membership · optional source hash
panels.description: Composer-reported candidate values, not authenticated canonical bytes or paid utilization. One source can belong to several generations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) AS time,e.instance,encode(e.epoch,'hex') AS epoch,e.payload#>>'{event,attempt,generation}' AS generation,'0x'||(e.payload#>>'{event,attempt,post_batch_hash}') AS posting_transaction,jsonb_array_length(e.payload#>'{event,members}') AS members,e.payload#>>'{event,encoded_bytes}' AS reported_encoded_bytes,e.payload#>>'{event,blob_count}' AS reported_blob_count,e.payload#>>'{event,blob_allowance}' AS reported_blob_allowance FROM eez.lifecycle_event_history e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp((e.payload->>'observed_at_unix_ms')::numeric/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) AND e.payload#>>'{event,event}'='attempt_prepared' AND (${source_hash:sqlstring}='' OR jsonb_path_exists(e.payload,'$.event.members[*].source.transaction_hash ? (@ == $hash)',jsonb_build_object('hash',lower(regexp_replace(${source_hash:sqlstring},'^0x',''))))) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Canonical applied endpoints
panels.description: Historical applied prefixes may share a height with a later current endpoint. Exact canonical L1 roots/correlation; not independent source replay or height-only finality. Query planning is separated by materializing only the scoped/time-filtered receipt identities and their matching endpoints.

targets.rawSql: WITH scope AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.chain_instance_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND c.role='l2' AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring})), receipt_window AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT p.chain_instance_id,p.transaction_hash,p.block_hash FROM eez.canonical_receipt_facts p WHERE p.source_valid AND p.role='l1' AND p.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(p.timestamp_seconds::double precision) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo())), selected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.l1_block_number,s.transaction_hash,s.transaction_index,s.number,s.hash,s.l1_finalized,s.source_valid FROM eez.canonical_settlement_endpoints s WHERE s.source_valid AND s.l2_chain_id IN (SELECT chain_instance_id FROM scope) AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR s.l1_chain_id::text=${chain:sqlstring} OR s.l2_chain_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM receipt_window p WHERE p.chain_instance_id=s.l1_chain_id AND p.transaction_hash=s.transaction_hash AND p.block_hash=s.block_hash)) SELECT s.l1_block_number::text AS l1_block,'0x'||encode(s.transaction_hash,'hex') AS posting_transaction,s.transaction_index::text,s.number::text AS l2_height,'0x'||encode(s.hash,'hex') AS applied_endpoint,s.l1_finalized,s.source_valid FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM selected) s ORDER BY s.l1_block_number DESC,s.transaction_index DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT c.role,c.chain_id::text,c.rollup_id::text,v.indexed_from::text,v.indexed_through::text,v.incomplete_blocks,v.last_success_at,v.collection_error,v.frozen_reason FROM eez.index_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring}) AND (${rollup:sqlstring}='all' OR c.role='l1' OR c.rollup_id::text=${rollup:sqlstring}) ORDER BY c.role

panels.title: Posting classification coverage · full indexed interval
panels.description: Decoded posting panels and blob coverage exclude unknown/invalid methods. This lifetime indexed-interval coverage is shown beside them; it is not limited to the dashboard time window. Unknown method rows do not become zero paid costs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.role,v.tracked_contract_receipts,v.decoded_post_receipts,v.invalid_post_calldata_receipts,v.other_method_receipts,v.unknown_method_receipts,v.method_collection_errors,v.last_method_attempt_at,v.source_valid FROM eez.posting_coverage v JOIN eez.dashboard_chain_context c USING(chain_instance_id) WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring} AND (${chain:sqlstring}='all' OR c.chain_instance_id::text=${chain:sqlstring})

panels.title: Planning cuts by reason
panels.description: One counter per real finite planning cut. Count, gas, DA, preparation deadline and queue cleanup retain request ownership as before. These are not unique failed requests. No sample means unexercised.

panels.title: Exact target misses by reason
panels.description: Scheduled-late slots and submitted-bundle target misses are separate operational observations; do not sum them into a unique failed-admission count. Exclusion can reflect auction loss, relay rejection or simulation failure.

panels.title: Active process policy values
panels.description: Immutable startup settings until restart. Setting names carry their units. NaN means inactive/unbounded (including interval in always mode), never zero or a consensus limit. Configured process values are not source-chain scoped.

panels.title: Policy anchor age · candidate target
panels.description: Actual enabled policy age: candidate L1 target minus last canonical L1 settlement timestamp. This is not the age of the oldest pending transaction. Only valid evaluations within45seconds are shown; rollup labels come from configured native runtime. Cross-chain and pure-L2 work may coexist.

panels.title: Included pure-L2 transactions awaiting settlement
panels.description: Fresh canonical policy activity index population, including reverted ordinary transactions. Empty history does not count as pure-L2 activity. Process/native rollup scope only; SQL source-chain selection does not change this process metric.

list.name: Native restart observations
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Native process epoch: '||e.liveness AS text,'restart' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_epoch_status e WHERE e.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND e.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(e.started_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200

list.name: Local policy dispositions
list.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) AS time,'Local disposition: '||t.claimed_outcome AS text,t.source->>'direction' AS tags FROM eez.lifecycle_local_policy_evidence t JOIN eez.lifecycle_coverage s USING(source_id) WHERE t.evidence_state='local_policy' AND s.deployment_id IN (SELECT deployment_id FROM eez.dashboard_chain_context c WHERE c.environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND c.deployment=${deployment:sqlstring}) AND s.instance IN (${instance:sqlstring}) AND (to_timestamp(t.observed_at_ms/1000.0) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) ORDER BY time LIMIT 200
